title: Ash
description: Galadriel wakes in a world of red ash. Isildur vanishes when a burning house comes down on him, and Míriel, struck by falling embers, loses her sight.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: Galadriel and Theo
description: Leading the boy through the burning woods, Galadriel speaks for the first time of the husband she lost in the war, and gives Theo a sword.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: The Grove, burned
description: The Harfoots arrive to find their orchard scorched by the mountain's fire. The Stranger's attempt to heal a tree goes wrong and they send him away — yet by morning the whole Grove is in fruit.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: The Stranger walks on alone
description: With an apple and a star-chart from Nori, the Stranger sets off toward the Greenwood to find his constellation.

title: The Mystics burn the caravan
description: The three white-robed hunters come looking for the Stranger and set the carts alight. Nori, Poppy, Marigold and Sadoc set out to warn him.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: No mithril for the Elves
description: King Durin III refuses to dig mithril for the Elves. Durin and Elrond dig anyway and strike a vast vein — the king catches them, banishes Elrond and strips his son of his rank.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: Something stirs in the deep
description: The king seals the shaft and casts the withered Elven leaf into it. Far below, the falling leaf wakes a Balrog.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: The Númenórean camp
description: Survivors gather outside the ash. Elendil mourns his son; blind Míriel vows that Númenor will return. Halbrand is found badly wounded, and Galadriel rides with him in search of Elvish healing.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: The Southlands become Mordor
description: Under the ash cloud the Orcs can walk by day. Adar strikes the old name from the land and gives it a new one.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com
